steps.title: Use the protocol supported by the toolkit
steps.detail: Use Composio’s OAUTH1 path. Trello OAuth 2.0 credentials and granular scopes are a separate flow; do not substitute them for consumer credentials.

steps.title: Generate your Power-Up API key and secret
steps.detail: Open trello.com/apps/admin, select your Power-Up and open Trello Auth. Generate an API key and keep its application secret for the custom connection.

steps.title: Create a custom Trello auth config
steps.detail: In Composio select Trello OAUTH1 and enter consumer_key and consumer_secret from your Power-Up. Trim the default read,write,account permissions to the actual tools.

steps.title: Confirm the OAuth 1.0 callback configuration
steps.detail: Inspect the callback requirements in the Composio dashboard or ask Composio support before connecting users. The OAuth 2.0 redirect used by other toolkits is not verified for this flow.

blocker.symptom: Authorization fails to return to Composio.
blocker.cause: The custom OAuth 1.0 callback configuration has not been verified.
blocker.fix: Confirm the required callback and provider allow-list settings with Composio before rollout.

steps.title: Confirm distribution requirements before inviting customers
steps.detail: Check whether your intended Power-Up distribution needs a separate review. Its requirements and turnaround are Unknown for this setup.

steps.title: Connect a test account and read one board
steps.detail: Use the custom auth config in the Playground or a Connect Link, authorize a test account and run a board-read tool. Test write tools on disposable data before launch.

steps.title: Handle revoked connections
steps.detail: When Trello rejects a revoked token, ask the affected user to authorize again. Include this recovery path in your product.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: Trello supports OAuth 1.0 with request-token, authorize-token and access-token endpoints. A Power-Up’s Trello Auth tab provides the API key and application secret.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: The legacy authorization permissions are read, write and account; account includes the consenting member’s email. Allowed Origins in this document governs return_url redirects.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: The live Composio Trello toolkit uses managed OAUTH1; custom configs require consumer_key and consumer_secret and default to read,write,account. No OAuth redirect field is exposed.

evidence.label: unknown
evidence.claim: The exact OAuth 1.0 callback/allow-list settings for the current Composio custom flow and any distribution review requirements remain unverified.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: Trello also documents OAuth 2.0 with more granular permissions and refreshable tokens. That protocol is distinct from Composio’s current OAuth 1.0 toolkit.

evidence.label: official
evidence.claim: Custom auth configs select your own provider credentials for a session through authConfigs.

access.note: This is the Composio OAuth 1.0 path; its callback setup and any separate distribution review must be confirmed before launch.
